properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.'; notes: 'Built to consolidate UCSF's global health programs and house approximately 1,500 faculty, staff, fellows and residents (Rudolph and Sletten) in a 266,000 sq ft building (WRNS; Rudolph and Sletten gives 264,000); OpenStreetMap tags it six levels. Architect WRNS Studio (design-builder Rudolph and Sletten per its own project page; landscape Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture per its own project page). Opened for occupancy September 2014, ribbon-cutting October 2014. Address note: this project's geometry is tagged 500 16th St from OpenStreetMap's own addr:housenumber, but an earlier pass recorded 550 16th St from UCSF's press release (which could not be re-read; the architect's project page gives no street address) -- flagging the discrepancy rather than silently picking one.'. 2026-10-06: accuracy audit (October 2026) fix. notes: 'Opened for occupancy September 2014, ribbon-cutting October 2014' now reads 'Completed 2014 (WRNS; Rudolph and Sletten)', with the September/October months attributed to the UCSF news story, which refuses automated fetches and could not be re-read. No change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcels and tax roll -- e.g. block/lot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: Built to consolidate UCSF's global health programs and house approximately 1,500 faculty, staff, fellows and residents (Rudolph and Sletten) in a 266,000 sq ft building (WRNS; Rudolph and Sletten gives 264,000); OpenStreetMap tags it six levels. Architect WRNS Studio (design-builder Rudolph and Sletten per its own project page; landscape Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture per its own project page). Completed 2014 (WRNS; Rudolph and Sletten); the September 2014 occupancy and October 2014 ribbon-cutting rest on a UCSF news story that could not be re-read in October 2026. Address note: this record's map shape is tagged 500 16th St from OpenStreetMap's own house-number tag, but an earlier version of this record gave 550 16th St from UCSF's press release (which could not be re-checked; the architect's project page gives no street address) -- flagging the discrepancy rather than silently picking one.
